title: Orchestrator plan
description: What the checkpoint planner writes to <run>/plan.draft.json. `orch.mjs plan <file> --check` enforces it (and more: ids unique, depends_on only points backwards, prototypes exist).

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the feature is when it is done.

checkpoints.description: Ordered simplest → most complex. Each is atomic: one reviewable behavior, green on its own.

title.description: Short, imperative: "Store tags on a guest".

intent.description: What changes for the user or the code, and why it comes at this point in the order.

files.description: Files you expect to touch. Advisory — the reviewer compares it with the diff.

acceptance.description: Observable behaviors, one per line, each one a test can prove: "Given…, when…, then…".

e2e.description: NEW spec files only — a path that existed when the run started is refused, because the e2e gates judge whole files and existing specs may already fail.

tdd_exempt.description: null, or the reason no failing test can come first (pure refactor under existing tests, config, copy). The human sees and approves it.

prototype.description: Path relative to the run dir: prototypes/<id>.html

screens.description: The states the e2e tests END on — each final screenshot is compared with the prototype.

risks.description: Open questions and risks the human should see before approving.

learnings.description: Feedback rounds only: rules for NEXT time distilled from the human's notes. Appended to LEARNINGS.md on import.
